test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five people P, Q, T, V and R are sitting in a circle facing away from the centre. P is to the immediate right of V, T is in between V and R. Who is sitting to the immediate left of R?
solution:
Given: Five people P, Q, T, V and R are sitting in a circle facing away from the centre.

1) P is to the immediate right of V.

2) T is in between V and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de903ddf95c6346aebb386de898915da08264bb1d0c6e7bfbc9821f710da0023.png] 

And, Q is sitting at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4083dc3cac581c6894695faae7c2b1d13f3dda2f3a0bbe39dd40ade69e39c1f.png] 

Here, 'Q' is sitting to the immediate left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
